page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-48-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 48 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 378.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. Although the structured local storage size is listed as None, the instance configuration includes 6 Local SSDs. There are zero GPUs associated with this server type, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, this server provides a high memory-to-vCPU allocation alongside dedicated compute resources. The lack of GPU acceleration makes it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. The high memory capacity relative to the vCPU count offers a qualitative balance for memory-intensive operations without requiring the overhead of a fully dedicated memory-optimized instance class.

This server configuration is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and storage optimization. Suitable use cases include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated x86_64 compute cores and high memory density.
